description.value: Mid-range hotel offering standard business amenities and reliable service. A predictable overnight waypoint for touring cyclists in Kamloops.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website prefetch failed with 403 Access Denied, so I rely on OSM data only. The OSM record is recent (check_date 2025-06-15) and indicates the hotel is not closed. OSM confirms WiFi via internet_access=wlan tag. This is a real, operating Fairfield by Marriott location -- a major chain with standard hotel amenities -- suitable for touring cyclists despite inability to confirm specific cyclist-amenity details.
concerns: Website prefetch failed with 403 Access Denied; most amenity details could not be verified from business website
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel. Chains are not grounds for exclusion; any useful waypoint for touring cyclists belongs in the directory.
